Maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize what goes into the Console observability launch next week. Main areas: dashboards (latency/cost/errors), tracing hooks (hot-paths only), cost breakdown (per-route + per-org coarse), error analytics (top errors + runbooks). Proposing a trimmed GA surface to hit reliability + cost targets. Thoughts?

Liam: +1 to trimmed surface. For tracing we should ship skeleton hooks for hot paths and a sampling strategy behind a flag. Full spans/stack traces can be premium.

Sophia: Must have basic error aggregation available for SRE (top 10 error classes, per-model error rate). We can defer deep correlation (logs + traces) but need runbook links for common failures.

Raj: Dashboard priority suggestion: 1) Latency P50/P95 per route/model, 2) Token-cost per request (rolling 1h/24h), 3) Error rate trend per model. Heatmap (cost vs error) is valuable but can be in phase 2.

Ella: Customer ask: a few enterprise pilots require per-org cost breakout + alerting on spikes. They also want role-based access to billing views. If we don't have that, they won't GA. Is opt-in fine? :thinking_face:

Maya: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
- Core dashboards: latency, cost, errors (sufficient for SRE + dev teams)
- Tracing hooks: hot-path span headers + sampling, flaggable by org/route
- Error analytics: aggregation + top-10 error types, links to runbooks
- Rollout: canary 2% -> 10% -> 50% with rollback SLOs
- Enterprise: per-org detailed billing behind opt-in + RBAC (GA not blocked for self-serve)

Liam: Implementation note: sampling & flag config can look like this:
```yaml
tracing: 
  default_sampling: 0.01  # 1% global
  hot_path_sampling: 0.10  # 10% for known hot routes
  org_overrides: {}
flags:
  console_observe_v1: off by default
```
We'll wire org overrides to Dedicated/reserved customers first.

Raj: To control cost, we should use short hot retention + aggregated long-term. Proposal: 7d raw spans/metrics, 90d rolled-up aggregates. That keeps storage delta predictable.

Sophia: Perf note — enabling span hooks on all requests increases p95 by ~0.7ms based on previous bench. So default off for free/tiered customers; on for pilot customers. Also need circuit-breaker if tracing storage throttles.

Maya: Tradeoffs acknowledged. Decision proposal: ship trimmed dashboards + tracing sampling + error aggregation; enterprise per-org billing as opt-in premium. Owners: Maya (PM), Liam (Eng), Raj (Analytics), Sophia (SRE). Canary schedule: Tue 09:00 UTC 2% for 24h, validate cost & error signals, expand to 10% if green.

Liam: I'll create PR w/ feature flag + sampling config and a canary playbook. ETA: EOD Mon.

Ella: I'll draft customer comms for pilot and list of pilot orgs. Also prepping runbooks for top 5 errors.

Raj: I'll surface telemetry queries + example dashboards for the canary so we can baseline cost and error changes.

Sophia: Will add circuit-breaker and SLO checks to oncall runbook.

Maya: Thanks — let's reconvene Mon 10:30 for final sign-off. If any blocker (esp RBAC/billing) shout here. :thumbsup:
